sections.label: Statutory minimum annual leave increase
sections.summary: The statutory minimum annual leave is seven days, rising yearly to a cap of 14 years, and the Employment Act review makes this the time to increase it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Presently, the statutory minimum annual leave under section 88A of the Employment Act is seven days, increasing by one each year, up to a cap of 14 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: With the ongoing review of the Employment Act, now is the time to increase the minimum annual leave.

sections.label: Caregiving in childcare and sick leave
sections.summary: The speaker proposes the Government consider letting employees use their own sick leave based on dependants' Medical Certificates, such as young children or elderly parents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Furthermore, we must recognise the reality of caregiving in our childcare and sick leave policies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I propose that the Government consider allowing employees to utilise their own sick leave based on the Medical Certificates of their dependants, such as young children or elderly parents.

sections.label: Working main applicant subsidy condition
sections.summary: Higher tier basic infant care and childcare subsidies are available only to a working main applicant, a mother or single father, working at least 56 hours monthly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Currently, the higher tier of basic infant care and childcare subsidies are available only to a "working main applicant", that is a mother or a single father for divorced, separated or widowed parents, who works at least 56 hours per month.

sections.label: Piloted infant childminding services
sections.summary: The speaker asks what preliminary observations have come from the infant childminding services piloted with three operators since December 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: At the piloted infant childminding services with three operators since December 2024, I would like to ask: what are the preliminary observations from the pilot.

sections.label: Netherlands and Taiwan postpartum care
sections.summary: The Netherlands' kraamzorg entitles every mother to 80 hours of trained maternity nurse home care, and Taiwan launched government-funded postpartum healthcare checkups in May 2025.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The Netherlands' "kraamzorg" entitles every mother to 80 hours of trained maternity nurse home care.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Taiwan launched government-funded postpartum healthcare checkups in May 2025, providing structured check-ups, including health and postnatal depression screening.

sections.label: Restructuring maternity leave for employers
sections.summary: The speaker proposes extending maternity leave to six months, fully Government-paid up to a salary cap, with an optional additional six months at half-pay, also Government-funded up to a cap.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: First, we should restructure maternity leave to make business sense for employers so that employers are better able to support career planning for employees who are mothers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I propose extending maternity leave up to six months, fully Government-paid up to a salary cap, with an optional additional six months at half-pay, also Government-funded up to a cap.

sections.label: Career Comeback Scheme tax deduction
sections.summary: Companies hiring stay-at-home parent returnees may get a tax deduction on the employee's salary for up to 12 months.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: In this Career Comeback Scheme, companies that hire stay-at-home parent returnees may qualify for a tax deduction on the employee's salary for up to 12 months.

sections.label: Subsidising elective egg freezing
sections.summary: The Government should consider partially subsidising elective egg freezing or allowing MediSave use for women marrying later.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: Fourth, to help women who are marrying later in life still have a chance at having a child, the Government should consider partially subsidising elective egg freezing (EEF) or allowing MediSave to be used for it.

sections.label: Side-by-side BTO units for families
sections.summary: Large families or two-family units could apply for side-by-side 3-room or 4-room BTO units with an option to knock down the dividing wall.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: If we want families to grow, we must give them the physical space to do so.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I propose allowing large families or two-family units, comprising elderly parents and couples with children, to apply for "side-by-side" 3-room or 4-room BTO units, with the structural option to knock down the dividing wall.

sections.label: Family Expansion Grant for resale flats
sections.summary: A Family Expansion Grant is proposed for the HDB resale market, as the leap from one to two children brings the hardest spatial crunch.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: The leap from one to two children is where the spatial crunch hits hardest, often requiring domestic help or a live-in parent.

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: I also propose a Family Expansion Grant targeted at the HDB resale market.

sections.label: Marriages and citizen births decline
sections.summary: There were about 24,700 registered marriages in 2025, down 6.2%, and about 26,100 citizen births, down 10.8% from 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Last year, there were about 24,700 registered marriages, a 6.2% drop from 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Singapore recorded about 26,100 citizen births in 2025, a 10.8% decrease from 29,200 in 2024.

sections.label: Calls for more leave days
sections.summary: Members and the public have called for more leave days, while working parents now have 30 weeks of paid parental leave.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Other Members in this House, on both sides of the House and members of public have also called for more leave days, such as childcare leave for those with more children or older children to cover school closure days and exigencies.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We recently enhanced our parental leave provisions, such that working parents now have a total of 30 weeks of paid parental leave to care for and bond with their infants.

sections.label: Flexible work arrangements guidelines
sections.summary: Tripartite Guidelines on FWA Requests were implemented in December 2024, with continued tripartite work to foster work-life friendly practices.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Flexible work arrangements (FWAs) are a key form of support.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We implemented the Tripartite Guidelines on FWA Requests in December 2024 and will continue to work with tripartite partners to foster work-life friendly practices and support employers in implementing them well.

sections.label: EEF financing and fertility costs
sections.summary: The Workgroup will review a suggestion to provide financing support for EEF and consider reducing fertility test and treatment costs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The Workgroup will review the Member's suggestion to provide financing support for EEF and consider ways to reduce the cost of fertility tests and treatments.

sections.label: Infant care and preschool places
sections.summary: Full-day infant care places nearly tripled and childcare places nearly doubled over the past decade, with 80% preschool commitment met.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Over the past decade, the number of full-day infant care places has nearly tripled while the number of full-day childcare places nearly doubled.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: At the end of last year, we achieved our commitment of ensuring that 80% of preschoolers can have a place in a Government-supported preschool.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The industry median childcare fee before means-tested subsidies has fallen to $680 last year, compared to $760 in 2021.

sections.label: Statutory minimum annual leave cap
sections.summary: The statutory minimum annual leave under the Employment Act goes up to a cap of 14 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Ms Chen, you have a clarification to make?

sentences.speaker: Ms Elysa Chen
sentences.text: I said that the statutory minimum annual leave under the Employment Act goes up to a cap of 14 years.
